ingredients.name: Red No. 3 (Erythrosine)
ingredients.health_effects: Thyroid tumors in animal studies (Delaney Clause trigger).
ingredients.warning_label: FDA revoked authorization Jan 2025. Manufacturer deadline to reformulate: Jan 2027.

regulatory_actions.note: Delaney Clause — carcinogenicity in animal studies

alternatives.name: Beet juice / beet powder
alternatives.reason: Natural anthocyanin coloring; GRAS; no carcinogenicity concerns

ingredients.name: Brominated vegetable oil (BVO)
ingredients.health_effects: Bromine accumulation in body fat; neurological and thyroid effects.
ingredients.warning_label: FDA revoked Jul 2024. Phaseout completes Aug 2025.

ingredients.name: Partially hydrogenated oil (trans fat)
ingredients.health_effects: Elevated LDL cholesterol; cardiovascular disease risk.
ingredients.warning_label: Check ingredient lists for "partially hydrogenated" in any form.

alternatives.name: Sunflower or canola oil
alternatives.reason: No trans fat; widely available substitute in baked goods

ingredients.name: Coumarin
ingredients.health_effects: Hepatotoxic at elevated doses.
ingredients.warning_label: Prohibited food additive; watch for tonka bean in artisanal/imported vanilla products.

ingredients.name: Cyclamate
ingredients.health_effects: Bladder tumors in animal studies.
ingredients.warning_label: Still found in some imported diet foods and beverages.

ingredients.name: Peanuts
ingredients.health_effects: Anaphylaxis; no established safe threshold.
ingredients.warning_label: No safe threshold. Anaphylaxis risk.

ingredients.name: Crustacean shellfish
ingredients.aka: Shrimp, crab, lobster, prawn, crawfish, krill
ingredients.health_effects: Anaphylaxis; must declare specific crustacean type.
ingredients.warning_label: Anaphylaxis risk. Declare specific type.

ingredients.name: Milk / dairy
ingredients.health_effects: Allergic reactions ranging from mild to anaphylaxis.
ingredients.warning_label: All milk derivatives must be declared.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.aka: Egg white, egg yolk, albumin, ovalbumin
ingredients.health_effects: Allergic reactions; common in coatings and glazes.
ingredients.warning_label: Present in coatings, glazes, binders.

ingredients.name: Fish
ingredients.aka: Anchovy, salmon, tuna, tilapia, cod, fish sauce
ingredients.health_effects: Allergic reactions; must list specific fish type.
ingredients.warning_label: Must list specific type.

ingredients.name: Tree nuts
ingredients.aka: Almond, walnut, pecan, cashew, pistachio, hazelnut
ingredients.health_effects: Anaphylaxis; each nut type must be listed separately.
ingredients.warning_label: Must list specific nut type.

ingredients.name: Wheat / gluten
ingredients.aka: Enriched flour, semolina, spelt, durum, gluten
ingredients.health_effects: Intestinal damage in celiac disease; allergic reactions.
ingredients.warning_label: Intestinal damage in celiac disease.

ingredients.name: Soybeans
ingredients.aka: Soy lecithin, tofu, edamame, TVP, miso
ingredients.health_effects: Allergic reactions; soy lecithin in release agents often overlooked.
ingredients.warning_label: Soy lecithin in release agents must be declared.

ingredients.name: Sesame
ingredients.health_effects: Anaphylaxis; newest Big 9 addition, audit legacy labels.
ingredients.warning_label: Newest Big 9 addition. Audit legacy labels.

ingredients.name: BHA (Butylated hydroxyanisole)
ingredients.health_effects: NTP 2021: reasonably anticipated human carcinogen.
ingredients.warning_label: NTP 2021: reasonably anticipated carcinogen. FDA considering ban.

alternatives.name: Mixed tocopherols (Vitamin E)
alternatives.reason: Natural antioxidant; GRAS; no carcinogenicity concerns

ingredients.name: BHT (Butylated hydroxytoluene)
ingredients.health_effects: Hormone disruption in animal studies; often paired with BHA.
ingredients.warning_label: Linked to hormone disruption. Often paired with BHA.

alternatives.name: Mixed tocopherols (Vitamin E)
alternatives.reason: Natural antioxidant; GRAS; no carcinogenicity concerns

ingredients.name: TBHQ
ingredients.health_effects: Immune system disruption in animal studies.
ingredients.warning_label: Linked to immune system disruption. Banned in Japan.

ingredients.name: Potassium bromate
ingredients.health_effects: Possible carcinogen; kidney and thyroid tumors in animal studies.
ingredients.warning_label: Possible carcinogen. California banned 2025. EU banned.

alternatives.name: Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C)
alternatives.reason: Dough conditioner with a well-established safety record

ingredients.name: Propylparaben
ingredients.health_effects: Endocrine disruption; estrogenic activity in lab studies.
ingredients.warning_label: Endocrine disruptor. California banned 2025. EU food ban.

ingredients.name: Azodicarbonamide (ADA)
ingredients.health_effects: Forms semicarbazide, a possible carcinogen, when baked.
ingredients.warning_label: Forms semicarbazide when baked. Banned in EU.

alternatives.name: Ascorbic acid or enzyme-based conditioners
alternatives.reason: Achieves similar dough strength without semicarbazide formation

ingredients.name: Sulfites
ingredients.aka: Sulfur dioxide, sodium bisulfite, sodium metabisulfite
ingredients.health_effects: Asthma and allergic-type reactions in sensitive individuals.
ingredients.warning_label: FSIS mandates declaration ≥10 ppm. Asthma risk.

ingredients.name: Nitrates / nitrites
ingredients.aka: Sodium nitrite, sodium nitrate, celery powder
ingredients.health_effects: Forms nitrosamines (probable carcinogens) at high cooking heat.
ingredients.warning_label: Forms nitrosamines at high heat. FSIS strict labeling rules.

alternatives.name: Cherry powder + starter culture (naturally-cured)
alternatives.reason: Achieves curing effect with lower free-nitrite formation

ingredients.name: MSG / glutamate
ingredients.aka: Monosodium glutamate, autolyzed yeast, yeast extract
ingredients.health_effects: Reported intolerance symptoms in sensitive individuals; often undeclared under alternate names.
ingredients.warning_label: FSIS-flagged intolerance ingredient. Often undeclared.

ingredients.name: Sodium benzoate
ingredients.health_effects: Forms benzene, a known carcinogen, when combined with vitamin C in acidic drinks.
ingredients.warning_label: Forms benzene with vitamin C in acidic drinks.

alternatives.name: Potassium sorbate
alternatives.reason: Does not form benzene in the presence of ascorbic acid

ingredients.name: High-fructose corn syrup
ingredients.health_effects: Linked to obesity, metabolic syndrome, and fatty liver disease.
ingredients.warning_label: Linked to obesity, metabolic syndrome, fatty liver disease.

alternatives.name: Cane sugar
alternatives.reason: Lower fructose ratio and better-studied metabolic profile at equivalent sweetness

ingredients.name: Carrageenan
ingredients.health_effects: Gut inflammation observed in animal studies.
ingredients.warning_label: Gut inflammation in animal studies. EU restricts in infant formula.

ingredients.name: Aspartame
ingredients.health_effects: Classified possible carcinogen by WHO/IARC 2023. Contains phenylalanine — PKU risk.
ingredients.warning_label: Classified possible carcinogen by WHO/IARC 2023. Contains phenylalanine (PKU risk).

alternatives.name: Stevia or monk fruit extract
alternatives.reason: No PKU risk and not classified as a possible carcinogen

ingredients.name: Acesulfame potassium
ingredients.health_effects: Gut microbiome disruption reported in animal studies.
ingredients.warning_label: Gut microbiome disruption. Methylene chloride residue.

ingredients.name: Caramel coloring (4-MEI)
ingredients.aka: Caramel colour, Class III/IV caramel color
ingredients.health_effects: 4-methylimidazole contaminant classified as a possible carcinogen.
ingredients.warning_label: 4-methylimidazole contaminant in Class III/IV. CA Prop 65 threshold.

alternatives.name: Annatto or turmeric
alternatives.reason: Natural colorants with no 4-MEI contaminant risk

ingredients.name: Polysorbate 80
ingredients.health_effects: Metabolic syndrome and gut barrier disruption in animal studies.
ingredients.warning_label: Metabolic syndrome in animal studies. Gut barrier disruption.

ingredients.name: Sodium phosphate
ingredients.health_effects: Linked to cardiovascular and kidney strain at high processed-food intake levels.
ingredients.warning_label: Linked to cardiovascular and kidney strain at high processed-food intake levels.

ingredients.name: Red No. 40 (Allura Red)
ingredients.aka: FD&C Red No. 40, Allura Red AC, E129
ingredients.health_effects: Possible behavioral effects in children; hyperactivity.
ingredients.warning_label: Multiple state school bans pending. FDA 2025 reassessment ongoing.

regulatory_actions.note: Behavioral warning label required on packaged foods

ingredients.name: Yellow No. 5 (Tartrazine)
ingredients.health_effects: Possible hyperactivity effects; rare allergic-type reactions.
ingredients.warning_label: FSIS mandates declaration by full name.

alternatives.name: Turmeric or beta-carotene
alternatives.reason: Natural yellow coloring with no synthetic-dye reassessment risk

ingredients.name: Yellow No. 6
ingredients.aka: FD&C Yellow No. 6, Sunset Yellow, E110
ingredients.health_effects: Possible hyperactivity effects; FDA 2025 synthetic dye reassessment.
ingredients.warning_label: FDA 2025 synthetic dye reassessment.

ingredients.name: Blue No. 1
ingredients.aka: FD&C Blue No. 1, Brilliant Blue, E133
ingredients.health_effects: Under FDA 2025 reassessment; state school prohibition bills pending.
ingredients.warning_label: State school prohibition bills.

ingredients.name: Blue No. 2
ingredients.aka: FD&C Blue No. 2, Indigo Carmine, E132
ingredients.health_effects: Part of FDA 2025 synthetic dye reassessment.
ingredients.warning_label: Part of FDA 2025 dye reassessment.

ingredients.name: Titanium dioxide
ingredients.health_effects: Genotoxicity concerns raised by EFSA; EU banned as a food additive in 2022.
ingredients.warning_label: EU banned 2022 (genotoxicity). FDA active review.

ingredients.name: Green tea extract (EGCG)
ingredients.health_effects: Liver and kidney toxicity reported at concentrated doses.
ingredients.warning_label: FDA twice rejected safety filing. Liver/kidney toxicity at concentration.

ingredients.name: Aloe vera
ingredients.health_effects: FDA banned aloe latex in OTC laxatives over safety concerns.
ingredients.warning_label: Self-affirmed safe without FDA review. FDA banned in OTC laxatives.

ingredients.name: Mushroom extract
ingredients.badge: Secret GRAS — one variety FDA banned
ingredients.health_effects: Cannot determine specific extract/species from label alone.
ingredients.warning_label: Cannot determine from label which extract. One variety FDA banned 2024.
